files.text:
CMOS domino AO21 gate with keeper
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
V0 a 0 PULSE(0 3.3 100n 100p 100p 99.9n 200n)
V1 b 0 PULSE(0 3.3 200n 100p 100p 199.9n 400n)
V2 c 0 PULSE(0 3.3 400n 100p 100p 399.9n 800n)
VCLK clk 0 PULSE(0 3.3 40n 100p 100p 59.9n 100n)
XDUT vdd 0 clk a b c out astra_059_cmos_domino_ao21_keeper
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec eval0 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec pre0 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec eval1 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec pre1 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec eval2 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec pre2 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec eval3 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec pre3 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec eval4 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec pre4 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec eval5 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec pre5 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec eval6 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec pre6 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec eval7 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec pre7 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 100p 800n
meas tran eval0 FIND v(out) AT=80n
meas tran pre0 FIND v(out) AT=25n
meas tran eval1 FIND v(out) AT=180n
meas tran pre1 FIND v(out) AT=125n
meas tran eval2 FIND v(out) AT=280n
meas tran pre2 FIND v(out) AT=225n
meas tran eval3 FIND v(out) AT=380n
meas tran pre3 FIND v(out) AT=325n
meas tran eval4 FIND v(out) AT=480n
meas tran pre4 FIND v(out) AT=425n
meas tran eval5 FIND v(out) AT=580n
meas tran pre5 FIND v(out) AT=525n
meas tran eval6 FIND v(out) AT=680n
meas tran pre6 FIND v(out) AT=625n
meas tran eval7 FIND v(out) AT=780n
meas tran pre7 FIND v(out) AT=725n
write out.raw v(out) v(a) v(b) v(c) v(clk)
quit
.endc
.end
